title: Pear and Gorgonzola Cheese Pizza
description: This easy Gorgonzola pizza is topped with slices of sweet and juicy fresh pear to make a unique cheese pizza with a delicious flavor combination.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package refrigerated pizza crust dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Place pizza crust dough on a medium baking sheet. Layer with Provolone cheese. Top cheese with Bosc pear slices. Sprinkle with walnuts and Gorgonzola cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven 8 to 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and crust is lightly browned. Remove from heat. Top with chives and slice to serve.

video.description: If you’re looking for surprising flavors in your next pizza, wow the pizza lovers in your house with pears, Provolone and Gorgonzola! Stretch out a round of pre-made pizza dough on your baking sheet, then concentrate on intriguing toppings. Layer the crust with slices of Provolone cheese, then thinly sliced Bosc pear, crumbled Gorgonzola cheese and chopped walnuts. Bake until perfectly melty with a lightly golden crust. Garnish with chives and serve slices as an appetizer at your next party or with a light salad for a memorable lunch.
